records.name: Central Philadelphia Transportation Management Association
records.notes: The website is Center City District's (centercityphila.org), a business improvement district funded by property owner assessments. The site never uses the transportation management association name and does not say the two are the same entity. The district runs public events (Open Streets: West Walnut, Center City Fit, Restaurant Week), but it is not a group a resident joins. Its affiliates were not fetched: the Center City District Foundation is a private foundation (out of scope). The site shows no dated items.

records.name: Círculo Español de Filadelfia
records.summary: A club for Spaniards and friends of Spain in the Philadelphia area, founded in 1976. Members gather for holiday dinners, members' meetings, and Spanish cultural events, and the club says it helps newcomers settle into life here.
records.what_you_do: Join as a member, then come to members' meetings and holiday gatherings. Take part in cultural events such as the Spanish flag-raising at City Hall and a ceremony at Sister Cities Park.

schedule.text: Members' meetings, holiday dinners, and cultural events are announced in the news section. Regular meeting times are not published.

cost.text: Membership is $45 a year (individual) or $60 a year (family).

first_step.how: Fill out the membership form on their website, then email cirespfila@gmail.com to ask about the next members' meeting.
first_step.basis: The group says it welcomes newcomers, but dues come first and the site does not show what a meeting is like before you join.

records.notes: Website and news are in Spanish. Membership form: https://circuloespanolfiladelfia.org/form/. Spanish is not a heritage id in the cheat sheet, so audience.community is empty. Some news dates on the site are inferred from image upload paths and are labeled that way there. Instagram posts linked from the news page were not read.

records.name: Civil War Museum of Philadelphia
records.summary: A Civil War history group in Philadelphia, chartered in 1888. Its old museum building closed in 2008, and its website now shows board members at outside history events and asks for support and board service.
records.what_you_do: Join the board or support the group with a donation. The site does not list current museum hours, tours, or volunteer shifts.

cost.text: Admission and hours are not shown on the site.

first_step.how: Email contact@civilwarmuseumphila.org to ask how to visit the museum or join the board, since the site lists no hours or volunteer dates.
first_step.basis: The site does not say how a visitor or volunteer gets started, and board service is the only way in it shows.

records.notes: Newest dated item on the site is December 2023 (a banner donated to the Union League). A navigation item names an essay contest for 2027, but it has no date, so it was not counted as evidence. The /visit page returned a 404. Chartered by the Military Order of the Loyal Legion of the United States. The IRS entry uses a PO Box (19102), which is not on the website. Verify before showing as active.

records.name: Columbus III Housing Development Corporation
records.notes: The website is Mission First Housing Group's site, an affordable housing developer and property manager. Its headquarters is at 2042 to 2048 Arch Street, the same address as the IRS entry. The site does not say how the IRS-listed corporation relates to Mission First. It is a property and development entity, not a group a resident joins. Its public items (a newsletter, donation pages, and Welcome Home 2026, a fundraising event) do not make it a community group.

records.name: CWA Local 13000 Community Service Fund
records.notes: IRS legal name: Communications Workers of America Local 13000 Community Service Fund. The batch website field held a name, not a web address, so it was treated as missing. One search found no public page for this fund. The only Local 13000 mention found was a western Pennsylvania toy drive (Alleghany-Fayette). Philadelphia CWA Local 13301 is a different local number. This looks like a union local's charity fund with no public way in, so it is hidden as private. Revisit if the fund publishes a public program.

records.name: Community Justice Partnerships
records.notes: The site lists three focus areas (justice and equity, sharing resources, celebrating community) but names no programs, events, or volunteer roles. Its events page says to stay tuned, and its support page says the information is coming soon. Address on the site: 100 S. Broad Street Suite 725-B, Philadelphia 19110. Hidden for no public way in yet. Recheck the site later.

records.name: Confident Queen Collective
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit that runs leadership, mental wellness, and life skills programs for teen girls, many delivered through schools and online. It also has a parent support team.
records.what_you_do: Teen girls take part in its live or online leadership and wellness programs. The site does not say how to sign up, so ask by email.

cost.text: Program fees are not shown on the site. Donations are the only money request shown.

first_step.how: Email info@confidentqueen.org to ask how a teen or parent can join a program, or sign up for monthly updates on the homepage.
first_step.basis: The site does not show how to sign up for a program or what a session is like, and it says to contact the group directly.

records.notes: IRS legal name: Confident Queen Collective Foundation Inc. The site has no dated events or news; the copyright year is not counted. A programs page at /programs returned a 404. The site says it has reached girls in 12 states and 286 schools, and the group is based in Philadelphia, but Philadelphia-specific offerings are not shown. Probably active is based only on a working site with no dates.

records.name: Consular Corps Association of Philadelphia
records.notes: Could not read. The batch website name did not resolve (DNS lookup failed), and no other public page was found. The name suggests an association of consular officers, which would mean no public way in, but that is not verified. Held back until a readable source shows who may join.

records.name: Delaware Valley Ornithological Club
records.notes: Could not read the club's own site. dvoc.org returned HTTP 403 and www.dvoc.org returned an expired-certificate error. One search returned summaries that mention 2026 walks (for example a June 14, 2026 walk at Dixon Meadow Preserve, and a February 21, 2026 winter walk listed by Haverford College). Those are search summaries, not pages read, so they are not recorded as facts. The same results name BirdPhilly (Philadelphia city trips with Philadelphia Parks and Recreation) as a possible lead, unverified. The batch address field only says Academy of Natural Sciences. Recheck the club's site before publishing.

records.name: Developing Hearts and Minds
records.notes: IRS legal name: Developing Hearts and Minds Inc. The website describes a licensed, private-pay home care agency for seniors and their families in Bucks and Montgomery counties and nearby areas. It lists no volunteer or community program, so it is a business, not a group. The batch street address is not on the site.

records.name: DP Arts Consortium
records.notes: Could not read. The website returned HTTP 403 to the fetch tool, so it is listed under blocked. No other source was checked. IRS legal name: DP Arts Consortium Inc. The batch address is an apartment number on Vine Street, so do not publish that address without a public source.

records.name: Epiphany Singers
records.summary: A non-profit choir of young adults in Philadelphia that sings traditional and modern choral music. Singers join through an audition, and the choir holds Open Sing-Ins where people can sing with the group for a day.
records.what_you_do: Sing in the choir after an audition, or come to an Open Sing-In to try it for a day. Concerts are open to the public, and tickets are sold for some of them.

schedule.text: Auditions, Open Sing-Ins, and concerts each have a dated event page on the site. Rehearsal days and times are not published.

locations.label: Concert and Open Sing-In venue
locations.address: 1723 Race St (Cathedral Basilica of Saints Peter and Paul)

cost.text: Concert ticket prices and the Open Sing-In fee are not shown on the site.

first_step.how: Use the audition page on their website to sign up for the next audition or Open Sing-In.
first_step.basis: Open Sing-Ins let people sing with the choir for a day and are listed publicly, but ongoing membership is by audition.

records.notes: Dated items on the site run from June 2025 to a concert listed for 2026-12-04, including the Open Sing-In of 2026-08-08. Legal name: Epiphany Singers. The page also lists an email on an unrelated domain, which was not recorded. Rehearsal times and ticket prices are not on the site.

records.name: FBI Philadelphia Citizens Academy Alumni Association
records.notes: IRS legal name: Fbi Philadelphia Citizens Academy Alumni Association Inc. An alumni association for FBI Citizens Academy graduates; the site says it is separate from the FBI. Its page lists 2026 events, including Give Kids Sight Day on 2026-10-03 at Wills Eye Hospital and a human trafficking event on 2026-11-02 at the Union League. But it does not say whether events are open to the public or who may join, and it shows only a PO Box in Conshohocken (Montgomery County) with no phone or email. Hidden as private: an alumni group with no public contact or sign-up. Reconsider if its public events get their own listings with a contact.

records.name: Federal Criminal Law Committee for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania
records.summary: A group of defense lawyers who practice federal criminal law in the Eastern District of Pennsylvania. Members meet for continuing legal education seminars and luncheons, and the group shares news about member cases and legal issues.
records.what_you_do: Lawyers who join the group attend its continuing legal education seminars and luncheons. Non-lawyers cannot join.

schedule.text: Seminars and luncheons are announced on the events page. The page lists no upcoming dates.

cost.text: Membership fees and event costs are not shown on the site.

first_step.how: If you are a member of the bar, register through the Become a Member page on their website, then watch for the next seminar notice.
first_step.basis: Membership is limited to lawyers, and the site does not show what an event is like before joining.

records.notes: Membership is for lawyers who are members of the bar, excluding current prosecutors and judges. The group says it has over 100 members. The events page lists only older events, so the newest evidence is the news dated November 2025. Whether events are open to non-members is not stated. No address, phone, or email appears on the site; the contact page is https://fclcedpa.org/contact/.

records.name: Friends of Columbus Square
records.summary: Neighbors who look after Columbus Square park. They host park cleanups, outdoor movie nights, and neighborhood events, and they want the park to be a shared space for everyone nearby.
records.what_you_do: Pitch in at park cleanups, come to outdoor movie nights and neighborhood events, and join the mailing list to hear about the next one.

schedule.text: Cleanups, outdoor movies, and neighborhood events. The site lists no dates; they are announced through the mailing list and social media.

cost.text: The site does not state a cost for events.

first_step.how: Sign up for the group's mailing list (http://eepurl.com/hSrJxH) to hear about the next cleanup or movie night.
first_step.basis: Cleanups and events are public and the mailing list is a clear way to join, though the site does not describe what a first cleanup involves.

records.notes: IRS legal name: Friends of Columbus Square Inc. The site has no dated items, and its /events page returned a 404. Probably active is based only on a working site with no dates, so check the group's social pages before trusting it. Address for the park is not on the site.

notes: Input file is batches/w20a-tier1-irs-web/02.json. The brief named 002.json, but this folder uses two-digit names, so agent 002 maps to 02.json. The batch holds 15 groups, not 20, and all 15 have a record. Verdicts: 9 publish (3 are unknown fallbacks that will be held back: Consular Corps, DVOC, DP Arts), 3 hide as private (CWA Local 13000 fund, Community Justice Partnerships, FBI alumni association), 3 not_a_group (Center City District under the TMA name, Columbus III Housing Development Corporation, Developing Hearts and Minds). WebSearch: 2 of 2 used (CWA Local 13000, DVOC). WebFetch: 23 used of 60, with no rate limiting. Refusals: 403 on dvoc.org and dpartsconsortium.org (listed under blocked). DNS failure on consularcorpofphiladelphia.org. Expired certificate on www.dvoc.org. A few guessed sub-pages returned 404 and were not retried. Leads: no leads_only entries. Troop K Cadet Camp (troopkcampcadet.com, named on the FBI alumni site) was fetched and dropped: it is an annual Pennsylvania State Police youth camp held in Schwenksville (Montgomery County) that takes Philadelphia County campers, so it is not a Philadelphia group. Center City District names affiliates (Center City District Foundation, Central Philadelphia Development Corporation); the foundation is a private foundation (out of scope) and was not fetched. Military Order of the Loyal Legion is named as the museum's charter body, not fetched, no URL seen. Search summaries named BirdPhilly and PA Audubon as possible leads for birding, unverified.
